scripts.db:init: node -e "const db = require('./server/config/database'); db.initializeDatabase().then(() => { console.log('✅ Database initialized'); process.exit(0); }).catch(err => { console.error('❌ Error:', err.message); process.exit(1); })"
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:test && npm run db:init
scripts.env:check: node -e "require('dotenv').config(); console.log('=== ENVIRONMENT CHECK ==='); console.log('DATABASE_URL:', process.env.DATABASE_URL ? '✓ Set' : '✗ Not set'); if(process.env.DATABASE_URL) { const masked = process.env.DATABASE_URL.replace(/:([^:@]+)@/, ':****@'); console.log('   Value:', masked); } console.log('NODE_ENV:', process.env.NODE_ENV || 'not set'); console.log('PORT:', process.env.PORT || 'not set');"
